title: Touch panel stuck
shortDescription: A capacitive touch button is reading as constantly pressed.
fullDescription:
Bosch range hoods report E01 when the control detects a touch input held longer than 60 seconds. Grease film, water droplets, or a cracked glass can simulate a permanent press.

Clean the panel with a degreaser and dry thoroughly. If the fault persists, the touch board needs replacement.

causes.cause: Grease or water on touch glass

fixSteps.title: Clean panel
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe with degreasing cleaner and dry fully.

whenToCallPro: If glass is cracked or board replacement is needed.
videoSearchQuery: Bosch range hood E01 touch error

faq.a: Yes, condensation under the glass can trigger it.

title: Filter saturation alert
fullDescription:
E02 indicates the cumulative runtime since the last filter clean has exceeded the threshold. The hood will continue operating but reduced suction is expected.

Wash the metal grease filters and reset the timer with the dedicated button.

fixSteps.title: Clean filters
fixSteps.instruction: Soak in hot soapy water and dry.

faq.a: Yes, on top rack with mild detergent.

title: Fan motor fault
shortDescription: Blower motor not reaching commanded RPM.
fullDescription:
E03 is shown when the BLDC blower fails to spin up or hold speed. Bearings, capacitors (on AC motors), or the motor driver can be at fault.

Disconnect power and rotate the wheel by hand to check for binding.

fixSteps.title: Check rotation
fixSteps.instruction: Spin blower wheel by hand to detect drag.

whenToCallPro: Most homeowners should call a pro for motor swap.

faq.a: Bosch hoods have 2 year parts warranty typically.

title: Light circuit fault
shortDescription: LED driver short or open detected.
fullDescription:
E04 indicates the cooktop LED light circuit is drawing the wrong current. A failed LED module or shorted harness will trigger the protection.

Replace the LED module; bulbs are not user-serviceable on most modern Bosch hoods.

fixSteps.title: Replace LED
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect power and swap the LED module.

whenToCallPro: If hardwired ceiling install is involved.

faq.a: Use Bosch part to ensure driver compatibility.

title: Damper not responding
fullDescription:
Hoods with auto dampers report E05 if the actuator does not reach its end position within the expected time. A jammed damper or failed actuator triggers this code.

Inspect the duct connection for obstructions and verify the actuator moves freely.

causes.cause: Damper jammed by lint or debris

fixSteps.title: Inspect damper
fixSteps.instruction: Open access panel and clear any obstruction.

whenToCallPro: If actuator is integrated with the duct.

faq.a: No, Bosch firmware will keep the fault active.

title: Communication error
shortDescription: Loss of bus communication with controls.
fullDescription:
E07 indicates the main board lost signal from the user interface or remote control module. Reseat the harness between the chassis and the control panel.

If the issue persists, replace the affected board.

fixSteps.title: Reseat harness
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, open canopy, reseat connector.

faq.a: Yes, try unplugging at the breaker for 5 minutes.

title: Overtemperature shutdown
fullDescription:
E08 indicates the motor driver or control board temperature sensor exceeded a safe limit. Heavy continuous use over a high-output burner can cause this.

Let the unit cool fully and ensure ductwork is not obstructed.

fixSteps.title: Cool down
fixSteps.instruction: Wait 30 minutes for fault to clear.

faq.a: Yes, kinked flex duct restricts airflow and overheats the motor.

title: Charcoal filter reminder
fullDescription:
Recirculating Bosch hoods show C1 every 6 months of runtime to remind users to swap the charcoal filter. The hood continues to function but odor removal degrades.

Install the matching Bosch charcoal filter and reset the indicator.

fixSteps.title: Replace filter
fixSteps.instruction: Twist out old filter, install new.

faq.a: No, charcoal filters must be replaced.

title: Fan capacitor failure
shortDescription: AC fan motor capacitor out of spec.
fullDescription:
On older AC-motor models, FC indicates the run capacitor is degraded. The motor will hum or run slow.

Discharge and replace the capacitor; observe polarity if applicable.

fixSteps.title: Replace capacitor
fixSteps.instruction: Discharge with insulated screwdriver before removal.

title: Control lockout active
shortDescription: Child lock or service mode engaged.
fullDescription:
LO appears when the control lock is engaged, either by user action or by a long button hold during cleaning.

Hold the lock button for 3 seconds to disengage.

fixSteps.title: Disengage lock
fixSteps.instruction: Press and hold lock icon for 3 seconds.

faq.a: Wiping the panel can trigger the lock combo.
